title: Feroz Shah Kotla Fort Delhi - History, Timings & Legends
content:
Feroz Shah Kotla Fort - Delhi’s Fort of Legends & Mysteries,

Feroz Shah Kotla Fort in Delhi is a 14th-century fort built by Sultan Feroz Shah Tughlaq. Once the heart of his capital city, Firozabad, this fort is now a mix of ruins, ancient structures, and fascinating legends that attract both history lovers and curious visitors.

The most famous feature of the fort is the Ashokan Pillar, a 3rd-century BC sandstone column brought from Ambala and placed here by Feroz Shah. The fort also has mosques, stepwells, and large halls that once showcased the power of the Tughlaq dynasty.

What makes Feroz Shah Kotla even more intriguing are the local stories of djinns (spirits) believed to reside here. Many visitors write letters or light candles, hoping their wishes will be fulfilled—a tradition that gives the fort a mystical charm.

Today, the fort may not be as grand as it once was, but its combination of history, architecture, and folklore makes it one of the most unique places to visit in Delhi. Located near the ITO metro station, it is easy to reach and explore.

Best Time to Visit: October to March, when the weather is pleasant. Late afternoons are great for photos and catching the evening prayers at the mosque.

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: Nearest station is ITO (Violet Line), just a short walk away.
  • By Bus/Auto: Easily accessible from central Delhi by DTC buses and autos.
  • By Car: Limited parking near the entrance.

Entry Fee:

  • ₹25 for Indian citizens
  • ₹300 for foreign nationals
  • Book Online Entry Ticket, 

Travel Tip: If you’re visiting on a Thursday, expect larger crowds and more offerings left for the djinns - it’s the most spiritually active day here.

faqs.question: Who built Feroz Shah Kotla Fort in Delhi?
faqs.answer: The fort was built in 1354 by Sultan Feroz Shah Tughlaq.

faqs.question: What is Feroz Shah Kotla Fort famous for?
faqs.answer: It is famous for the Ashokan Pillar, ancient ruins, mosques, stepwells, and the legends of djinns.

faqs.question: Where is Feroz Shah Kotla Fort located?
faqs.answer: The fort is located near ITO, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi, close to Feroz Shah Kotla Stadium.

faqs.question: What are the timings and entry fees of Feroz Shah Kotla Fort?
faqs.answer: Open daily from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Entry is ₹25 for Indians and ₹300 for foreigners.

faqs.question: Why do people write letters at Feroz Shah Kotla Fort?
faqs.answer: Many visitors believe the fort is home to djinns (spirits) and write letters or light candles to seek blessings or fulfill wishes.
